news.title: Travis Etienne Jr. quiet in Week 10

news.contents: New Orleans Saints running back Travis Etienne Jr. made his return to the field on Sunday after being sidelined since suffering a hamstring injury in Week 3. He got back into the mix on Sunday, but fantasy managers might not have even noticed that he was back. Etienne carried the ball eight times for 14 yards, while hauling in three of his five targets for an additional 20 yards through the air during the loss to the Carolina Panthers. It's possible that the Saints were easing Etienne back ...
news.title: Travis Etienne Jr. is Quiet in Return

news.analysis: Kyren Williams got the start for the Rams per usual, but Corum wound up being the hot hand on the day in the Rams backfield. He also added three receptions on the day. He remains a steady RB2 for fantasy managers, especially with the Rams wide receiver room banged up.
news.contents: Blake Corum ran for 100 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 3-of-4 targets for 19 yards receiving.
news.title: Blake Corum runs for 100 yards Sunday

news.contents: Los Angeles Rams running back Blake Corum was a man who wouldn't be stopped on the ground during Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals. Corum continued his hot stretch of play during this divisional contest. He carried the ball 17 times for 100 yards and scored a touchdown in the win. Corum also added three receptions on four targets for an additional 19 yards through the air. The 25-year-old has now found the end zone in four straight games. He also set a new season-high in rushing yards ...
news.title: Blake Corum Raises Fantasy Stock with Stellar Performance

news.contents: New York Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers did not speak to the media after the team's 24-21 loss to the Washington Commanders. For the first time in his three years with the team, Nabers did not address reporters after the game. In Week 10, Nabers caught just five of seven targets for 44 yards, as he's slowed after a hot streak from Week 4 to Week 7. The third-year receiver had a chance on a 50/50 ball at the end of the game to get the Giants in field goal range, but the pass was intercepted ...

news.contents: Indianapolis rookie wide receiver Deion Burks has not produced much this season, but better days could be ahead as his role and playing time expand. The Colts traded away Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, so that opens the door for wide receivers to step up, and Burks could be one of those guys. He has just nine targets over nine games played so far, catching six for 60 yards. He's also gotten three rushing attempts, gaining 21 yards. He's logged just 15.6% of the team's offensive snaps so far, ...

The star pass-rusher's loss deals a significant blow to a Lions front seven that will look for others to fill the void on the defensive line moving forward.

news.contents: Detroit Lions defensive end Aidan Hutchinson is feared to have suffered a significant knee injury that could sideline him for the foreseeable future, according to Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo. Hutchinson landed awkwardly while celebrating a first-quarter sack of Drake Maye in Sunday's 35-10 Week 10 win over the New England Patriots. news.contents: Tennessee Titans quarterback Cam Ward enters Week 10 coming off easily his best performance of the season, and quite possibly his career, completing 26 of 40 passes for a career-high 304 yards and two touchdowns against Cincinnati before the bye. Ward also added a career-high 41 rushing yards, becoming the first Titans quarterback with 300 passing yards and 40 rushing yards in a game since Marcus Mariota in 2018.
